war_declared.text: The council of {my_faction} has spoken on {enemy_faction}. I merely moved the motion. The blades will do the rest.
Let it be minuted that {my_faction} did not seek this war. {enemy_faction} simply forgot to read the charter.
{enemy_faction} was given three chances to be reasonable. I have counted them all, and so has the council.
Grievances, once tabled, have a way of becoming campaigns. {my_faction} is only following procedure, as ever.

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} have agreed terms. A pleasant outcome, though I confess I had hoped for a slightly longer quarrel.
The truce with {faction} is signed, and I shall be the first to say I drafted the clauses.
Peace with {faction} is a fine thing for the ledgers. Do try not to mistake a pause for a permanent arrangement.
{my_faction} has made its peace with {faction}. The council will meet next week to decide who gets the credit.

player_joined_my_faction.text: Welcome to {my_faction}, {player}. I do hope you find the council's benches comfortable. They are rarely kind to newcomers.
I see you have sworn to {my_faction}, {player}. Wise, I think. Do let us discuss your ambitions over a quiet word soon.
{player} now sits under the banner of {my_faction}. How brave. The council will watch with interest to see how long it lasts.
Your oath to {my_faction} is a fine decision, {player}. I have already drafted a seat for you on the next council.

player_left_my_faction.text: {player} has left {my_faction} for {faction}. A bold move. I am sure the council will minute it with great sorrow.
I notice you have taken your oaths to {faction}, {player}. Do not worry, I shall not table the matter. Yet.
Changing banners is hardly a crime, {player}, though I would have preferred to hear it from you first, over tea.
So {player} prefers {faction} to {my_faction}. Truly, I am only noting the change in seating arrangements.

player_granted_fief.text: {fief} now answers to {player}. A splendid appointment, and one the council endorsed with barely a dissenting voice.
So {fief} has gone to you, {player}. I do hope the duties suit your talents. The ledgers are rather unforgiving.
{player} has been granted {fief}. I shall reserve my applause until I have read the accounts for the first season.
Congratulations on {fief}, {player}. Should you need allies on the council to keep it, you know where to find me.

whisper_alliance_offer.text: {player}, {rival} has been courting {enemy_faction} behind the council's back. I would rather we dealt with that together.
A word of caution, {player}. {rival} speaks warmly of you in public and quite differently elsewhere. Shall we compare notes?
Join me against {enemy_faction}, {player}, and we shall see {rival} lose the next vote. I can promise you the seat.
There is little love lost between us and {rival}, {player}. An alliance against {enemy_faction} would serve us both nicely.

my_faction_took_fief.text: {fief} has fallen to {my_faction}. {enemy_faction} will call it a raid. The council will call it a mandate.
The banners of {my_faction} now fly over {fief}, taken from {enemy_faction}. Motion carried, and well carried.
{fief} is ours, and {enemy_faction} may wonder how a single vote cost them a castle. I shall not explain.
Let the record show {my_faction} holds {fief}. I drafted the resolution, so I am obliged to be pleased.

player_took_my_fief.text: {player} has taken {fief} from us. A tidy piece of work, if one overlooks the gaps in the defences I was promised.
{fief} is yours now, {player}. Enjoy it. I have a long memory and a longer list of motions.
Well taken, {player}. {fief} was never quite the jewel I described to the council. Do keep the walls in good repair.
So {player} has marched into {fief}. The council will want an inquiry. I shall be delighted to chair it.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: Agreed, {player}. Let us strike at {rival} while {enemy_faction} is still busy counting its coin. I will draft the terms.
Your offer is accepted, {player}. {rival} has annoyed too many people, and I am only too happy to be the one who says so.
Very well, {player}, we ally. {enemy_faction} will hardly expect the two of us to agree on anything, which is precisely the charm.
I accept, {player}. Mind {rival} does not hear of it before the council does. Such things have a way of leaking.

encounter_alliance_no.text: No, {player}. I have seen how you treat your allies. I would sooner trust {rival} with my purse, and that is saying something.
I must decline, {player}. The council is not yet persuaded, and {rival} would take it poorly. Perhaps another season.
Regretfully no, {player}. Your offer is generous, but {rival} holds a seat I need, and I cannot be seen to tear it up yet.
Not today, {player}. Let us see how the next vote goes before we bind ourselves to anyone, least of all {rival}.

ambient_chatter.text: The rain over {town} has made the council benches damp and the members damper. Motion to adjourn, I think.
Has anyone else heard the fishermen of {village} are petitioning for a new dock? Excellent. Another item for the agenda.
The roads from {village} to {town} are a disgrace. I shall raise the matter, and then I shall raise it again.
Heard the market in {town} is quiet this week. Quiet markets make for quiet councils, which suits me well enough.
